You're not kidding?!
Well, another one got eaten. Let our people know mutants have settled in that area.
We cleared that place just yesterday, were supposed to make a path... Damn...
I already told everyone not to go there—there are tons of beasts! Why didn’t anyone post it on the network?
He was a good man, a gutsy one... He shared his loot when times were hard... Rest in peace, fellow stalker!
Another one went into the Zone. When will they learn? Everyone knows you should go in pairs at the very least!
They tore that wanderer apart! No way—I’d put a bullet in my own head first!
Riiight... Where did he run into them...? I should copy down the coordinates...
They keep killing the beasts, but there are more and more of them...
The critters are breeding like crazy—there’s no room for a stalker to move!
You say an animal killed him?
Look at all these tourists... They can’t even take down a beast anymore...
There are so many mutants now, you can’t get through on foot or by vehicle!
DM me! Let’s organize a safari.
I found a body! I wouldn’t wish that death on anyone.
A monster tore him to pieces.
Serves him right!
Ah, the Zone... How many lives you’ve taken...
This reminds me of a joke...
Well, I’ll be...
By the way, I wonder what kind of beast that was?
I’d rip those monsters’ balls off so they couldn’t breed anymore!
It’s always sad when a mutant spawn eats a stalker... even if he was an enemy.
Guys, these mutants are freaking me out...
How sad...
Well, the guy died. It happens. Sooner or later, we’ll all end up as mutant food...
Good riddance, the strongest survive!
I told him those creatures were roaming around there! He didn’t listen, and look how it turned out...
Loser.
I can’t believe it... He kept saying it was safe there... Good thing I backed out at the last minute, or I might be lying next to him now...
Yeah... Went out for loot... Fate...
What can I say... The Zone isn’t a place for a stroll.
A terrible death! I hope the poor wanderer didn’t suffer...
The guy got killed!
He was probably a good man...
Just yesterday we were sitting by the campfire, telling jokes, and now this...
A bullet whistled by, and that was that.
I didn’t understand a thing.
One moment he was here, the next he was gone.
May the Zone rest lightly on you, man.
The nicest way to die in the Zone is by a bullet. Much better than ending up in a mutant’s claws, believe me.
The poor guy’s suffering is over...
At least a monster didn’t eat him—that’s something!
Looting is wrong, of course... But he definitely won’t need his gear anymore.
They killed a man like that!
He lived without fear and died without fear!
Those bastards...
Well, shall we drink to the deceased’s soul?
Well, that’s just incredible...
Time to collect the trophies!
Here we go!
Every day, the same thing...
I heard he had plenty of enemies.
No, I really don’t get it...
Well, well. Let’s see, where was that again...
Those bastards...
That’s curtains, boys.
How does that saying go—chiki-briki, and off to play dead?
It happens. That’s the Zone.
Here we go again...
They whistle like bullets past your temple... Moments, moments, moments...
A bullet to the temple is a bitter lesson.
It’s sad to see this...
What a shame...
Uh, what happened there?!
He’s in a better world now.
Hmm, the body is still warm. Looks like the killer is nearby!
Ah, that Zone...
This is what happens to those caught in an emission.
Poor zombie, I think he’s trying to communicate.
What’s that? Are they looking for a way to the people?
Remember: seek shelter at the first sign of an emission, or you’ll share their fate.
Zombie FM on your favorite radio frequency!
Does anyone understand what he’s saying?
Hey, guys, trust me. Some zombies are trying to say something.
What is he trying to say?!
What a cute zombie! That’s what happens to people who watch “Psychic Battle”!
Damn, I’m completely out of ammo.
Damn, there are so many of them now...
Whoa! I’m coming! Just... okay... Wait, who took my knife?!
Less talk, more action.
Oh, come on... I’d better save my ammo.
Yeah, it’s a good time for a hunt. Who’s coming with me?
Never underestimate a mutant, or you’re done for.
Anyone who comes at us looking for lead will get stuffed with it!
Huh, nothing unusual. I thought...
Here we go! Who else is coming with me?
Oh, perfect chance to put my gun to the test.
Damn...
Really? Great, my gun is ready.
Those creatures again... they killed my friend.
Fierce beasts... Stay alert.
Yeah. Anyone up for handing out some lead?
So you’re looking for a thrill? We’ll give you one!
Keep your distance and avoid drawing attention unless you plan on dying today.
Don’t play the hero. A couple of those beasts wiped out an entire squad a few days ago.
Damn! Men, take up your weapons!
Hang in there! I’ll try to send the hunters the intel now.
Sending a message to everyone nearby.
Here we go!
Seriously?!
Well then, let’s go, and sing along!
Is that confirmed? I hate those creatures...
I hope we have enough ammo.
Damn, there are so many of them around here...
Damn... We have to leave.
Where are the hunters?!
Maybe I should put this weapon to the test, hmm...
I’d better get out of here while I still can...
Damn, I left my hunting backpack at camp!
Someone’s looking for trouble... Well, we’ll give it to them.
Maybe these are the bastards who killed my friend... I’ll finish cleaning my gun, then the fun begins.
So much for getting some rest...
I’ll inform the others now.
Is that certain? Is there no one else?
Probably a scout...
Check the area. There must be someone else!
Watch our rear and flanks.
Keep your guns ready.
Take them out immediately if things start going south.
I should get my gun ready; that’ll put me at ease.
How reliable is this information?
They’re probably planning something. We need to stay sharp.
Damn, can you be any more specific?! Where did you see them, at least?!
Riiight, what are those bastards up to over there?
Take them out!
Shoot them in the head right away! Finish them off on the spot if necessary!
It’s all so sad... I recently had to kill a zombified friend. I wouldn’t wish that on anyone.
One walking corpse is nothing. A whole crowd is another matter.\nIf you spot that, report it immediately.
What, should I hold your hand and show you how it’s done? A bullet to the head, and it’s over.
Probably looking for his brains that spilled out.
I'd tear those monsters' balls off so they couldn't breed anymore!
Damn, that guy got unlucky!
Well, guys, I hope the poor sod didn't suffer for long...
Well, let's drink to the soul of the stiff!
Those monsters have gone too far. I'll go tell the Duty guys that the beasts are running wild here.
There are so damn many of these beasts now!
Damn, guys, I know him! We were drinking at the 100 Rads just yesterday, and now this...
What can I say... he was a loser, that's all.
What a loser, he couldn't fend off even that pig!
Damn, another punk got eaten.
Good thing I wasn't nearby!
It's always sad when a monster eats a stalker... even if he was an enemy.
Guys! People are dying in droves here, while Duty keeps bragging that they've secured the area from monsters! Aren't they a bunch of bastards?
Another one went to feed the beasts...
Damn, another one got eaten. Tell our guys that mutants are running wild here.
The mutants have multiplied like crazy; you can't get through here!
Guys, these monsters are unbelievable...
I told him those creatures were roaming around there! He didn't listen, and this is what happened...
Loser...
I can't believe it... I kept saying it was safe there... Good thing I backed out at the last minute, or I might've ended up lying next to him...
Well... went out for loot... That's fate...
What can I say... the Zone isn't a place for a stroll.
How sad...
A horrible death! I hope the poor drifter didn't suffer...
We cleared that place just yesterday; we were supposed to make a path... Damn...
I already told everyone not to go there; there are tons of creatures!.. Why didn't anyone post it on the network?
He was a good man, and a brave one. He shared his loot when I was in a tight spot... Rest easy, brother stalker!
Another fool went into the Zone. When will they learn? Everyone knows you shouldn't travel alone; go in pairs at the very least!..
The drifter was torn apart!.. No way, I'd rather put a bullet in my own head first!
Hmm... Where did he run into it..? I should mark down the coordinates...
They keep killing the creatures, but there are more and more of them...
The wildlife is multiplying; stalkers can't take a step!
You say an animal killed him?
Well, the guy died, it happens. Sooner or later, we'll all end up as mutant food...
Look at all these tourists flocking here; they can't even kill a monster...
Message me privately! Let's go after the monster.
I found a body! I wouldn't wish a death like that on anyone.
The monster tore him to pieces.
Serves him right!
Ah, Zone, how many lives have you ruined...
This reminds me of a joke...
Well, that's something...
By the way, I wonder what kind of creature that was?
I think I'll get out of here.
To hell with him!
What kind of student crowd came here to get themselves killed?
The monster tore him to pieces.
I wouldn't wish a death like that on anyone.
This is just awful...
Damn, there aren't even any bones left!
He was a good man...
Stalkers! Watch out. Looks like monsters have nested here, which is why they're acting aggressively. Better go around instead of charging into their lair like some damn superhero!
What the hell?!
One more, one less...
He lived without fear and died without fear!
He was a big, strong guy until he caught a bullet...
Well, guys, shall we drink to the soul of the deceased?
And the dead guy's a good sort; he'll share with me, right?
It's the perfect time to collect trophies!
Why do people shoot each other here? It's already hard enough to survive!
It's like this every day...
Damn, I feel sorry for the kid. What else can I say...
No, I really don't get it...
You're doomed, you bastards!
We’ll all end up there.
I'll put that punk in a wooden coat right now, damn it!
Chiki-briki, and you're dead!
The stalker closed his eyes for good.
Well, it happens.
Well, well, I should check what he had on him, hehe.
Damn, I could hear that from here!
Another day lived, another life lost...
We should have a toast in his memory...
May the Zone rest lightly on you.
I knew it—he kicked the bucket!
Damn.
This is fucked.
It’s completely fucked.
We should wipe them all out...
It’s a total mess, basically.
I knew him. It’s a shame about the guy.
In short, it’s complete crap.
Bastards! They got a good man killed! I'll find them and tear them a new one!
One more corpse, one less corpse, heh!
Oh! Sidorovich, even though I didn't kill him, you still owe me!
Bartender, what do I do now? Fine, I'll go check the body; maybe that info is on the flash drive... If anything comes up, message me.
Would you look at that, he had a gun like that and still couldn't defend himself... I'll go take a walk and pick up his weapon... And just so you know, I called dibs first!
A dog's death for a dog.
Those jackals have gone completely feral. It's high time those freaks were put down...
Bastards! Damn them! They've completely lost their fear!..
Uh... So, brothers?! Who's with me to take out those rats?!..
Maybe he took his own life?
When will this ever end?!..
Damn it! I thought I'd taken them all out...
Damn, I only saw him yesterday... Poor guy...
Rest in peace. He was a good stalker... I'll pick up his PDA; maybe there's still some loot...
What's happening to the Zone..? We used to go looking for loot and fear monsters and anomalies, but now we have to watch out for fellow stalkers too...
The military dropped new weapons into the Zone. If only I could get my hands on one...
Poor guy...
Another one lost in the Zone...
There was a tough guy, and now he's gone...
They really did a number on the guy.
I haven’t seen this kind of crap in a long time.
That guy sure got unlucky...
Those bastards killed my friend. I'll beat the hell out of the murderer!
First mutants, then bandits, zombies, fanatics, the military... I'm sick of it! Everyone's just trying to screw you over!
Well, the guy died. It happens, doesn't it?
Come on, let's get some vodka and drink to the deceased!
Heh-heh, let's see what the deceased had on him!
So, did anyone manage to loot the stiff or not?
Well, another rival has passed into the next world... Amen!..
And he said he was invincible! Heh!
Damn, he owed me money!
I knew he’d push his luck too far...
What did he have on him? Did the killer take everything?
They got a good man killed!!!
Serves him right!!!
I'm nearby! I can help!
Those bastards killed my friend! Guys, did you see who did it? If you did, message me privately.
One less old-timer.
Hey! That loser’s gear is mine!
I have a bad feeling about this...
Keep the channel clear! So a guy died... it happens all the time.
I've seen that guy. He should've been taken out long ago.
That’s it, hang yourselves, you bastards!
One down.
Phew! Thank God I didn't go on a run with him today. I had a feeling!
Good thing I wasn't nearby. I could feel it in my gut!
Yeah, yeah, the poor guy was just unlucky.
The guy keeled over!
That guy's done for...
Damn! Sounds like a firefight nearby!
And the heretics are getting fewer and fewer...
Fewer people means more oxygen.
Those idiots really did start a firefight!
Another one...
Well, what can I say... being a loser is just his fate!
That's right. He shouldn't have acted so cocky.
Let's see what you had on you...
Let's see if there's any loot.
Well, well! What have we got here?
All right, let's inspect the corpse!
Now then, respected deceased, what treasures did you have?
Hold on there, buddy. Lie still for five more seconds and I'll take your stuff. You won't need your gear in the next world.
So, what interesting things did this guy have in his pockets?
Let's have a look...
Riiight...
They put him in the coffin... his dick poked through the ceiling... Just reminded me of that song about Grandpa Maxim, heh.
The man got killed!
They killed such a good man!
Those scumbags! I'll find and kill whoever did this!
It's sad to see this...
What a shame...
Uh, what happened there?!
I'll find whoever did this!
Hmm, the body is still fresh. The killer must be somewhere nearby!
So, what loot did the stiff have?
Yeah, not a day goes by without this.
He was a good man...
Just yesterday we were sitting by the campfire telling jokes, and now this...
Well, the guy died. If you're looking for work, go see Sakharov! He pays good money for parts from mutant beasts! His assistant, Semenov, I think, always needs help studying the creatures.
Ooh, great! I had a contract on that ghoul, and now he's already been taken out! Less hassle for me!
There was a man, and now there isn't.
May the Zone lie lightly on you, buddy.
The nicest way to die in the Zone is by a bullet. It's still better than ending up in a mutant's claws, believe me...
The guy's suffering is over...
At least a monster didn't eat him, that's something!
I should pick up his loot before someone else gets here...
A ragged wound in the chest. I don't know the exact circumstances of death.
Found in a pit near a rusty BelAZ truck. He was emaciated, and a bloodsucker had a knife in its back.
His insides are a bloody mess; looks like bullets with an off-center mass.
His leg was found five meters from the remains. Looks like a trampoline did it.
Judging by the wounds, a chimera's claws got him. I'd better leave; night is coming. You should stay away too.
It's unclear what happened; the guy was simply torn apart.
Looks like a radiation burn.
I found a PDA near the body. I don't know why the recorder turned on... but the recording is nothing but half an hour of screams. Not a scratch on the guy. Creepy...
Found a mutilated body. A knife lies nearby, trembling slightly. I can't imagine what happened here...
A polished-to-a-shine skeleton in untouched gear. Rats, it seems.
Gnawed down to the bone. Rats.
Both arms broken, neck twisted. Damn, what did this to him...?
His skull was pierced.
A burst tore through his shoulder. No bandages; he died from blood loss.
His skull was crushed almost on level ground. Either someone helped him along, or he was careless after all. I told him to watch his step.
Well, it happens.
What a joke!
Poor thing.
Sorry... someone looted my stash recently too.
You should've hidden it better.
I should stock up too, I guess.
How much does it usually go for?
I could use some of that too...
Do you know if there's a discount on medkits or PPE?
Are there discounts on anything good?
Yeah, I could use some supplies...
I should've bought toilet paper instead... I'm sick of using these damn burdock leaves...

$clr_1Anonymous\n$clr_2There is nowhere to run. He sees each of you, knows you and your dark thoughts. You are not brothers, for you do not know what brotherhood is. So free your desires. Do it, and He will accept you.
$clr_1Anonymous\n$clr_2We were destined to betray the purification to the faithless! Monolith has blessed his servants.
$clr_1Anonymous\n$clr_2Know this, unbelievers: we are strong and you are weak. Run, and we will catch you. Hide, and we will find you.
$clr_1Anonymous\n$clr_2Trust no one but the Monolith and your brothers. No one.

$clr_1Anonymous\n$clr_2Damn gun jams again! And after the Duty technician at the Bar worked on it! What can you expect from a drunk? Stay away from him, lads.
$clr_1Anonymous\n$clr_2What are those clowns hanging around the farm? Great gear... not mercs, are they? I am too scared to approach.
$clr_1Anonymous\n$clr_2The Swamps are restless: you can sink up to your neck, beasts dig up from the ground, and now soldiers with helicopters are swarming around.
$clr_1Anonymous\n$clr_2Nobody writes to the Colonel... Nobody waits for the Colonel...
$clr_1Anonymous\n$clr_2How long will those mutts keep running in front of the Bar? When will Duty deal with them? To hell with you! I am joining people who keep their word.
$clr_1Zhurov\n$clr_2All right, brats, stop provoking my men at the perimeter. Our patience will soon run out, and we will shell your whole village with mortars.
$clr_1Anonymous\n$clr_2I thought I would come here to hunt mutants and see all the new gadgets. And what do I get? I sit at this checkpoint doing nothing! Great!
$clr_1Hawk\n$clr_2O-o-oh, can anybody see... We have a war to fight... Never found our way...

$clr_1Anonymous\n$clr_2I am fed up, fed up with everything... monsters... these stalkers are scum. And those damn anomalies!

$clr_1Owl\n$clr_2Stalkers! I accept PDAs with any valuable information. Bring everything you find to me. I will pay well.
$clr_1Transparent\n$clr_2Hey, lads on raids: if you take any PDAs from corpses, bring them to me. We can agree on the price.
$clr_1Transparent\n$clr_2Lads, if you find any toolkits, bring them to me! I am completely out.
$clr_1Scrooge\n$clr_2I buy PDAs containing valuable information. Bring them to me and I will pay in cash.

$clr_1Gromov\n$clr_2I urgently need tools, so bring me anything suitable that you find.

Repent. The end of your existence, steeped in lies, is approaching. Repent before it is too late.
Drown in despair, for your time has come.
We are the harbingers of a new era. Repent!
Our methods are savage, but our intentions are noble.
We are a necessary evil.
You cannot escape your fate!
Artifacts are gifts from the Zone. You have no right to reap them. But we will cleanse you.
We will pave the road to peace with the skulls of those who stand in our way.
Join us or die. Join us or die! JOIN US OR DIE!!!
Overthrow the tyrants! Kill the killers!
And let each of you be cleansed!
Repent! For the Zone’s wrath is near.
Kill millions so billions may live in peace.
Repay evil with evil.
A moment of violence, an eternity of peace.
Do not resist change.
We will start a war to end all wars.
Stalker, join us on the last crusade.
We declare war only in the name of peace!
We will eradicate greed and malice from this world.
The Monolith sows, the Monolith reaps.
O Great Monolith...
And we will achieve peace with our bloodied hands. The infidels will be cleansed.
Keep the airwaves clear! Nobody cares about your exploits killing random guys. If you knew about ours, now that would be something...

Hey, you Freedom idiots, catch your goons who decided to act clever and start trouble [4 attached videos, 137 MB...]\nDump your loot and play dumb one more time, and we’ll bury you up to your necks as dog food. You miserable, conniving bastards.
Two squads spotted—Freedom and Duty, contact in 200 meters. Preparing to jam communications.
Excellent sniper urgently needed. Payment: 15% of the contract value.
%c[255,160,160,160]Dushman\n%c[default]Once the snipers take their positions, move out and check the perimeter. The sentries saw some movement. We don’t need any more neighbors.

%c[255,160,160,160]Hog\n%c[default]Looks like that student and the botanist weren’t lying. The Sin faction really has become active, constantly seeking contact. They’ve left their old bases. We’ll check how things are going in Limansk now...
The group led by Kirill Yatagan has plans of its own now. They are no longer with us; remember that.
Andrey Lunev, known as Old Man, is being hunted.\nAny information about his whereabouts will be well rewarded.
%c[255,160,160,160]Max Kruger\n%c[default]I’ll pay well for information about the Old Man, or provide other information you need in return.
Experienced stalker wanted, preferably a veteran tracker. Come to the rally point; coordinates are in the PDA...

Should we shell Limansk with mortars after all? Right on the fortified positions where those bastards are holed up? We would definitely take the city!
 
%c[255,160,160,160]Anonymous
%c[default]Sure, and then the pros and military stalkers will shove your mortar right up your ass.
To join us, find a middleman—that is your first task. Your second task is to stay alive afterward.
Damn, every time scientist stalkers and Duty guys roll in, my finger goes for the trigger. And I thought guarding eggheads was an easy job.
Hey, you lousy heroes! Is the construction site covered in honey or something? Stop crawling in there! Want to live? Then get out of here.

Dushman, the guys say they spotted some bastard among the apartment blocks in Urban last night. Could it be a Monolith freak?
 
%c[255,160,160,160]Dushman
%c[default]Post snipers and keep your eyes open. I’ll gather the fighters for now.
The fighters from Wild report seeing some black thing. They avoided a firefight, so we need to ask our egghead contacts what the hell this new thing is.\n[2 attached images, 4 MB...]

%c[255,160,160,160]Dushman
%c[default]Any word from Griffin’s squad?
 
%c[255,160,160,160]Mercenaries
%c[default]No, still nothing.
Vector, we picked up a couple of prisoners near the gas station. They wouldn’t talk there. We’re bringing them to the base.
Damn, I shouldn’t have taken that order for this lousy artifact. I’ve been shaking down stalkers for days, and got nothing...
%c[255,160,160,160]Colin\n%c[default]If you find parts in good condition or any tools during your raids, bring them to me.

I don’t get it, Dushman—what are those thugs doing at our spot?
 
%c[255,160,160,160]Dushman
%c[default]Kill the bastards. I’m sick of these brainless scumbags.
The eggheads shared new info on anomalies, Dushman. I put it all on the laptop.
Aslan is a legend. He came up with a great lottery scheme. I won an artifact and closed the contract to find it right away.

The Arkharovtsy leaked info on our targets. I’ve already sent their coordinates and IDs to everyone on our side.
 
%c[255,160,160,160]Vector
%c[default]Let’s get to work, girls!
The guys came back from Ryzhy, Dushman. They saw some shady bastards. They avoided a fight—who knows how many of those new freaks are hiding in the trees. We should find out what’s going on.
Attention, everyone! The Clean Ones report that soldiers are now warming their asses at the machine-tractor station. Watch out if you end up there!
Damn, I wonder how Griffin and the others are holding up. Alone in a whole city full of fanatics... What a fucked-up situation...

Hog, we found some crate... Looks like weapon parts, tools, and other junk. Want it to tinker with? It’s not far to haul, anyway.
 
%c[255,160,160,160]Hog
%c[default]Oh, now we’re talking! I’ll throw a party at camp! Just toss all the rusty stuff, but bring anything that’s still halfway decent.

SOS, damn it! We need the nearest squad, urgently! We were crossing the Ravine when the army hit us from their APC. We have wounded! We’re heading through the woods toward Dark Valley. Send someone to meet us, Dushman!
%c[255,160,160,160]Aslan\n%c[default]Word is, Sidorovich has organized a hit on one of our guys. I have just one question: what scumbag left any witnesses?! What a brilliant choice of personnel...

Another elegantly executed contract. So damn clean! Those idiots could have arranged some transponder check. It’s easy—sew on a patch, walk in, and quietly wipe out the whole squad. And they’ve put up checkpoints, ha-ha.

Aslan, as you asked: we caught the intruders, stripped their gear, and put the owners in the funnel. What next?
 
%c[255,160,160,160]Aslan
%c[default]Put on the suits and wait. The clients should arrive in 25–40 minutes. You may rough them up, but don’t finish them off!
Heads up! We took out a military stalker squad. The dead had interesting info and a couple of locked PDAs. We’ll handle the bodies and return to base with the data.
Experienced stalkers wanted for a raid against a faction.
As ordered, we perfectly ruined the meeting between Duty and the army. Let them chase the Free Stalkers now, heh-heh.
Duty, have you lost your minds? One more order like that and all the material goes to Freedom.
Experienced stalkers wanted for a raid in Pripyat. Likely enemy: the Monolith faction.
Experienced mechanic wanted, preferably familiar with night-vision devices. Easy work, decent pay.
Dushman, Johnny here. Target successfully eliminated [3 attached images, 2 MB...]\nGet the cash ready, I’m coming home.
No, we won’t sign up for that. We’ve had enough of that mess with Freedom in Dark Valley—every person still counts. Maybe bandits or some other random punks will agree; good luck to them...
Brothers, the truth will be with us: the defenders and guardians of this sacred land. Purgatory awaits the infidels, and the worms cannot flee the coming revelation, for He has given the sign.

Brothers, why have you gone silent? Report the situation.
Brother Rabbit, the brothers in the Citadel are short on provisions. We must send hunters. It is time to reap the fruits of the Monolith’s gifts.

Stalker, look at what scientific activity has done to this world. It challenged the foundations of the world, and YOU are exactly who we need to make it better. Given the reality before you, YOU must understand that with the brotherhood anything is possible. Paradise on Earth is possible. Just help us preserve this miracle. Join our ranks.
Brothers, where are you? Sector p_5 is undefended.

Comrades, scientists, abandon your thankless work. The fruits of your labor will sooner or later end up with an oligarchic minority, while you yourselves will be forgotten. The brotherhood needs highly qualified specialists and can offer you the limitless knowledge of the Monolith.
A servant of the Monolith lost faith in the Great One and His vision in the control room. Brothers, cleanse it and consign the fallen servant to the sacred fire of purification.

Our brother has fallen, but his loyalty to Him has not. The worms were punished, thinking their fate had been cheated. But the Monolith knows, the Monolith sees, and waits for the inevitable cleansing to drench the sacred land in the blood of infidels.
The brothers from the Citadel are speaking. We are short on equipment. We request assistance.
Mentor speaking with a group of novices. We are clearing the approaches to Pripyat. Be careful, brothers; we are operating on the PDA.
Inquisitor speaking. Several of our brothers have lost their minds and left the shrine. If you meet them near Pripyat, save their souls. Free them from their torment.
Brother quartermaster from the KBO asks for a blessing. His servants need more 5.45×39 ammunition.
Brothers! Infidels have been spotted on the western outskirts of Limansk. Immediate action is required.
May the infidels never break the chains of our loyalty to Him. Our strength lies in unity—a thing the filthy worms lack.
Remember, brothers: with every cleansed infidel, the strength of His knowledge grows!
The brothers successfully stopped the infidels from reaching Him. Fools!
The servants of the Monolith managed to cleanse a group of infidels of their vices. We ask the Mentors to help move the new servants.
Glorious singing filled His temple yesterday. The faith of His servants knows no weakness.

A servant of the Monolith saw hostile brothers near Pripyat. They kept their distance and did not wish to share a prayer to Him with their brother. Monolith, why do you not preach to me... Monolith...
The sons of the Monolith stopped the heretics in the Sacred Forest. They sprinkled its soil with blood, and the Monolith will rejoice at the trial His servants endured.
The servants of the Monolith managed to cleanse a group of infidels of their vices. We ask the Mentors to help move the new brothers.
Listen to the words of Mentor Charon, brothers: “Eternal darkness, cold, and heat await those who dare to set foot on His sacred land.”
The Monolith has seen everything. He knows that every attempt by the infidels to delay the Great Day is futile.
Attention, brothers at the Suppressor: it is time to lower the power for cooling. Go to the bunker and assess the equipment immediately. Secure the perimeter so no infidel can get past us.
A vision of a black chimera on the outskirts of the station, in sector ast_1, was sent to the servants of the Monolith. Thank you, Monolith. Thank you for the glorious hunt to come.
Brothers! A rabble of infidels dared to defile our land! Bring purification to sector aes2_m1. The Monolith has seen their fate and blessed us!

A servant of His detected a suspicious signal coming from His Temple. Mentor, may this servant of the Monolith inspect His chambers?
 
%c[255,160,160,160]“Monolith”
%c[default]Absolutely not, brother. The Great Monolith values your concern and service, but asks you and your brothers to pursue another objective, for the good of His servants.
Brothers, respond. Are you at the location yet?

And He revealed the return of His servants to the sacred land. They fulfilled the Great One’s will and drenched the fertile land in the blood of infidels. He sees you all, worms. Yet the Monolith is merciful. He gave you time to cleanse yourselves of sin. He postponed your end. But you rejected His grace; you rejected His offer. And for that, only His punishment awaits you.

Hey, old guard! Remember how we gave the army hell on the Cordon? They were too scared to stick their noses past their checkpoint. Yeah... Those were the days! Not like now... The green ones have lost their sense of adventure, you know. Wonder if Valerian is still alive—and if so, how he’s doing...
I hope I don’t lose that one in the silver... That lovely, looovely one...
If only Duty and Freedom would stop bickering. By now we could have wiped out all the fanatics and made the Zone safe. Their ideologies can’t possibly make them that blind!

I buried a friend yesterday, guys... Those Arkharov bastards ambushed us as we were approaching the Dump from the Bar. I don’t know how to live without him now. I think I’ll empty my stash and spend it all on ammo and gear to shoot those scumbags.
 
%c[255,160,160,160]Anonymous
%c[default]My condolences, buddy.
 
%c[255,160,160,160]Loners
%c[default]I’m sorry for your loss, pal, but don’t let anger get the better of you. Rage and revenge won’t help. Come to our camp instead; we’ll remember your brother and figure out what to do next. Coordinates attached.
Hey, who stole my magazines?! I spent ages trading for those... What kind of animals...
The hunters asked me to remind you that chimeras and snorks come out at night, so be careful on raids, guys. Better to lie low!
After the shot, empty eyes. Only thoughts at night, sleeplessness...\nWho will give an answer, sound advice... Dawn is coming soon...\nYour life—does it exist, or not?
Maybe we could tame a pseudodog? Has anyone tried? A dog is man’s best friend, after all. It could chase snorks and thugs away at night, and it barely needs feeding!
Hey, guys! Those of you who’ve been to Jupiter and near Pripyat—did you hear voices like ghosts too? Or am I imagining things?
...Young winds blow from the south, tearing clouds apart; a traveler from afar won’t raise dust—home, mother, and a love that still remains.\n \nAh, brothers, I miss home so much!

Guys, don’t enter the Old Hangar from the west! How many times do I have to say that bandits like setting ambushes there?!
 
%c[255,160,160,160]Anonymous
%c[default]Heh, suckers.

I met some hunters returning from the Ravine. Their backpacks were stuffed with meat and trophies, and they said there was even more game out there. Wow...\nAnyone want to head out there for a week and shoot some animals?
Guys! Look what I found! [attached image, 851 KB...]\nWhat kind of artifact is this? I’ve never seen one before!
They say the mercenaries have some kind of lottery for patches, or something related to them. Damn, now they might kill you for no reason at all!
Damn, I lost a photo of my wife somewhere in camp... Guys, has anyone seen it? I’ll reward whoever finds it or buy them a drink. It means a lot to me.

A friend of mine joined the military stalkers recently. He said everything would be fine and he wouldn’t shoot if we met. But now I wonder whether he’ll keep his word... A stalker can make plans, but the Zone decides.
Good thing someone gave the Bartender a whole music collection. We could move to Rostok permanently now.
...Phew, damn. I’m alive! Barely escaped the dogs; I even had to ditch my backpack... Hope nobody finds it.

Still, it sucks that Duty pulled out of Yantar. It used to be much safer to travel to the Bar or the scientists through Dark Rostok—the Duty patrols knew their job. Now mutants, thugs, and mercs run everything again, so I have to take a huge detour through the Dump, damn...

Guys, does anyone know what the army is doing in the Swamps? I thought I’d meet the Clean Ones at the Mechanic’s and have a chat... Yeah, right! When they fired a PKM burst overhead, I panicked, ran into the radioactive reeds, and bolted!

Have you heard about the stalker who made it all the way into the Sarcophagus? And he wasn’t even Strelok! They say he found some never-before-seen artifact, but those Monolith bastards wouldn’t let him take it. Imagine how many unknown artifacts could be found there!
Credit where it’s due to Cerberus: holding out at the Barrier for so long is impressive. The man is doing the right thing, though the rookies down south probably don’t even know about him.
Some bastard keeps robbing my stashes... I spent two months collecting that toolkit. Two damn months! Just let me catch you, you lousy tinkerer! I’ll unscrew your bolt!

You’re really getting on our nerves. How many times does Sidorovich have to tell you not to provoke the soldiers at the checkpoints?! Haven’t you had enough raids? One fine day they’ll flatten the Village with a chopper. Idiots!
So, which idiot got drunk and went out last night to shoot at the loudspeaker at the checkpoint again? You’re asking for trouble. I swear you are, once Sidorovich hears about this.
Ah, I haven’t seen my family in four years...
Ah, I could use some entertainment... Brothers, how about we hit the Arena today or tomorrow?
I’m back from the mainland. It couldn’t hold me—the Zone kept calling me back. Now I just need to find my people, if they’re still alive... Has anyone seen Father Diodor?

You lured me in,
You led me astray;
You, my young love,
Drove me out of my mind!
Damn it! Which butterfingers left their tea open on the table?! It soaked all my cigarettes, for crying out loud!
I’m wondering: should I save up for an exoskeleton, or get something simpler and lighter, with enough left over for a full set of upgrades?
I saw Duty and Freedom killing each other all over the place again... What fools...
I still haven’t seen winter in the Zone. I’m bursting with curiosity about what it looks like under all that white!
Brothers, you have no idea how creepy Pripyat gets at night. It’s terrifying! Every little rustle makes you press yourself against a wall!
If I find out who stole my slab of fat by the campfire, I’ll turn him into lard myself! Damn thieves!
Good grief, I heard a child crying in the forest last night! It chilled me to the bone... What was that?!
Back from the north empty-handed again... I need to change my route. No point risking my hide for nothing.
They say Monolith scouts are sometimes seen at night in the Dark Valley. I don’t know about you, but I’m definitely not risking a look.
Yeah... That was a good hunt. We sold the Butcher a haul of trophies worth a fortune!

Some acquaintances tell me they’ve stopped camping overnight at the Vehicle Graveyard. Apparently, something paranormal goes on there at night: among the old cars you hear laughter one moment, someone’s voices the next, and it all seems really close, but there’s nobody around! They say it really gets on your nerves.

We took in an Arkhara member the other day. He was pretending to be one of our brothers and had even managed to get hold of an almost intact Sunrise suit... but his behavior gave him away. As they say, an animal is an animal, even in Africa.

A couple more successful raids like that, and maybe I’ll finally pay off my debts on the mainland, with enough left for a little house in some village... I miss my wife and kids so much, my darlings...

You know, it’s true what they say: live and learn. I found some manuals in the old workshops... While waiting out an emission, I flipped through them, remembered some things and copied others down. Recently I dreamed up an idea at night—to make a couple of armor modifications based on those manuals, with help from some old tools I borrowed from the technician. And guess what? I built them! The gear really is tougher now!

What a hassle. The trader gave me a whole crate of vodka for completing a job. What am I supposed to do with it?!

Oh, I can’t stop yawning.
At least there are no oversized mosquitoes here.
Good thing I decided to set out early this morning; otherwise I wouldn’t have made it back before dark.
Who’s on watch tonight?
Don’t sleep... Don’t sleep... You mustn’t...
I’m getting sleepy... I could really use an energy drink right now.
It’s getting dark... We should wrap things up soon.
Well... Today hasn’t been much of a day. At least it’s almost over.
I’m getting sleepy again... Knew I should’ve taken a longer nap this morning.
I had such a strange dream last night... I swear I won’t sleep a wink tonight.
Go on, guys... They’re heading out tonight... to hunt bloodsuckers... alone. What a bunch of daredevils.
So, who’s coming with me to take out a pack of pseudodogs today? I’m afraid to sleep in a tent at night—what if that dark one asks for water again... Better wander around somewhere.
Damn, I hope tonight will at least be quiet...
Attention, everyone! Scientists report suspicious mutant activity in Yantar tonight. Everyone stay in your camps.
Damn... It’ll start in a couple of hours... Where did I put that pack of sleeping pills... Must remember to take them and sleep in camp until morning...
Guys, is anyone nearby? It’s getting dark, damn... I’ve got a bad feeling...
Good grief, sunset’s almost here, and then it’ll be dark with nightmares! Anyone nearby, guys?
Beautiful dawn! Just like in Sevastopol, sigh...
It’s morning already?! I completely overslept...
Guys, dawn is breaking... What a beautiful sight.
Dawn is breaking...
Dawn is near; there’s no escape—time to turn the key and take off!
Hey, it’s getting light. I think we can move out now; we’re less likely to run into anyone than at night.
It’s light out. Let’s move! It’s relatively safe now.
Guys, wake up! It’s morning already!
Morning at last. We can crawl out of the underground... Those damn beasts drove us down there.
Ah, guys! It's finally getting light. I'm tired of trembling in the dark. Better to tremble in daylight...

Can anyone hear me? A group of our guys went missing last night. They were supposed to return from Agroprom by morning, but they're still not back. We're heading out to look for them in an hour. Join us.
Ah, it's still beautiful here!

Guys, you should see the sunrise here at Yantar. It's something else... Frightening and beautiful... And the snork corpses drift so nicely across the lake, glittering in the morning sun... So romantic...
Damn... My whole back... Everything hurts. How do you sleep in these sleeping bags...?
At moments like this in the morning, I always remember my childhood and my village: you'd get up early and watch light and shadow play in your room, and everything seemed... unreal, almost magical.
This is a dreadful morning.
Ah, I used to have very different things to do in the mornings.
I spent all night laying bricks at camp. That's how creepy it is at night!
Time to get up again, sigh.
Those banderlogs were howling all night, what are they called... burers? No, got it—fractures!
Feels like evening already...

I keep staring up at the sky,

And I just had to head out in weather like this...

I should go get some booze; this rain's going to last a while.
